data.explanation: This is the final bill (Schlussrechnung) for roofing work already completed on your gutters. You need to pay €1,249.50 to the company's IBAN by the deadline shown, quoting the invoice number DZ-26-0419 as the payment reference. The letter does not state what happens if you pay late, but late payment could lead to reminders or interest under general German law. Keep this invoice for your tax records, as craftsman labour costs on your home may be partly deductible. No objection or legal remedy is mentioned, since this is simply a payment request, not an official decision.
